subject: Fleet eligibility check and soft-allocation request — Crescent Labs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fleet eligibility check for Crescent Labs (late-stage)

Marissa / Karthik —

Crescent Labs (DEAL-4429-CRES) is in late-stage legal + procurement and they asked us to confirm that we can hold a soft allocation for them if they sign by mid-October. High-level ask from the AE: 30x A100-class GPUs sustained for 6 months, with a ramp profile (10/10/10 over 30 days).

Can infra confirm current free capacity across our us-west and us-east pools, and whether we can apply a soft hold that won't impact other P1 commitments? If we need to suggest a fallback (quantized model run or mixed-instance pool), outline that too.

I attached our latest inventory export from yesterday. Ben

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot-20260924.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet eligibility check for Crescent Labs (late-stage)

Ben —

Quick summary after a cursory capacity check:
- us-west (primary): ~48 free A100-equivalent slots; enough to cover 30x sustained if we stand them up across two racks.
- us-east (secondary): ~22 free slots, higher churn due to scheduled maintenance 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07.
- We currently have 3 other committed Dedicated deals that are flexible (can tolerate burst to spot for 2–4 weeks) but two near-term P1 commitments in Oct require strict isolation.

Options:
1) Soft allocation in us-west for 30 GPUs with a 21-day hold window (no preemption) — requires manual sign-off from capacity ops; we can put a soft tag to prevent overcommit.
2) Hybrid approach: 20 reserved in us-west + 10 quantized inference instances (mixed precision) in us-east as standby with automatic fallback. This reduces thermal/queue risk.
3) If Crescent cannot accept hybrid, we can propose a dedicated pool start date of 2026-10-15 but require a 25% ramp fee to guarantee hardware assignment.

I'll run a deeper slot-by-slot check and raise a capacity ticket if you want the soft allocation in place today.

-Marissa

Attachments: (none)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T13:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet eligibility check for Crescent Labs (late-stage)

Adding a technical note: if Crescent opts for the hybrid approach we should also precompute a quantization profile for their top 3 models (per the MLP). That buys us predictable latency on the 10 quantized GPUs and reduces token cost. I can assign an engineer to run quick evals if the AE wants this as a condition.

Also: consider enabling prefix caching for their top traffic routes to reduce sustained load during ramp.

-Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@crescentlabs.ai>
Cc: procurement@crescentlabs.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-26T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fleet eligibility check and soft-allocation request — Crescent Labs

Sophie —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our conversation we ran an internal capacity check and can support your target of 30 A100-class GPUs. To keep the deal moving while legal finalizes the SOW, we can place a soft allocation for 21 days on 30 GPUs in our us-west pool with the following conditions:
- Soft allocation does not reserve networking or IP addresses; those are provisioned at onboarding.
- If legal signs before 21 days, we convert to a hard allocation and schedule start.
- If we reach a firm P1 conflict during the soft window (unlikely), we will offer two alternatives: a hybrid 20/10 split (quantized fallback) or push the start date with a prioritized ramp.

Next steps for Crescent: please confirm you want the 21-day soft allocation and share the name/email of the legal/PO contact so we can loop them in. I've attached our mutual action plan (v2) for tracking milestones — please review and we'll add signatures to DocuSign once the PO is ready.

Ben

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.docx
From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@crescentlabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@crescentlabs.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet eligibility check and soft-allocation request — Crescent Labs

Ben —

Appreciate the quick check and the clear options. Crescent confirms we want the 21-day soft allocation while legal completes the PO. Legal contact is Maya Rios (maya.rios@crescentlabs.ai).

We'll review the MAP and aim to get the PO to you by 2026-10-08. Please proceed with the soft allocation and let me know if you need anything else from our side.

Sophie
